digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline — Ubuntu test job optimization
propositions: Ubuntu default test cells consume 30.2 runner-minutes per Verified run (py3.11=615s, py3.12=634s, py3.13=563s baseline) and contribute disproportionately to queue contention despite lower completion-path impact than macOS

Bridge cadence test invokes workflow YAML parsing 1440 times inside exhaustive minute comprehension, consuming 5.7 runner-minutes per run with identical parse output repeated; hoisting the single parse preserves all 1440 exhaustive minute checks while eliminating I/O redundancy

Pandoc render_unit and hardening suites invoke real Pandoc 3421 times total across corpus/legacy boundary pairs; legacy oracle can be replaced with static immutable golden fixture keyed by Pandoc version and binary fingerprint while retaining all 884 live product conversions in external revalidation workflow

AST provenance fixture setup consumes 46–55 seconds across three Ubuntu cells by repeatedly rediscovering parent/caller relationships via ast.walk iterations; building persistent indices once per process preserves all 24 (key, expr, verdict) tuples and guards

Complexity-lock static policy runs identically in every Ubuntu/macOS matrix cell (52–55s Ubuntu, 45s macOS) despite being language/Python-invariant; one invocation in existing lint job eliminates four duplicates across matrix with zero coverage loss
Jira DC integration tests are already excluded from Verified hot path via 'not integration and not external' selector and routed to weekly/manual external harness; no remediation saves time here
